== Transcription notes ==

Notes from transcribing the decklist sheet ([[:File:2008 Worlds Day 1.pdf]]):

* Incomplete player name as written. Sheet title I never have time to make new Light Sides. Start line partially illegible (They're… / We'll Handle…); MWYHL used from Tatooine junkyard / remote planet package.

== Decklist checked against the scan (2026-10-16) ==
Transcribed from the scanned sheet (Day 1 PDF page 34). Line 1 is The Hyperdrive Generator's Gone / We'll Need A New One; the deck also has Queen's Royal Starship ×2. The page moved from [[2008 Worlds Day 1 Walseth LS Mind What You Have Learned]]. Deck title on the sheet: ''I never have time to make new Light Sides''. Line 28 is Krayt Dragon Howl (V); the old list read it as Leave Them To Me (V), a Dark Side card. Shields 10–11 are written Wise Advice (V) and A Tragedy Has Occurred (V) (December 2006 [[Virtual Set: Defensive Shields]] printings). Shield 12 is written "Affe… Mind" without V. The only Light Side shield of that name is [[Affect Mind (V) (Virtual Set 2: Our Most Desperate Hour) (Remastered 2006)|Affect Mind (V) (Virtual Set 2: Our Most Desperate Hour)]]. The old list had "Affirmative", which is not a card. [[User:Holocron Claude|Holocron Claude]] ([[User talk:Holocron Claude|talk]]) 19:49, 16 October 2026 (UTC)
